en: Black‑and‑white vertical view through a pointed archway onto a cobbled street leading to a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire topped by a cross. There is a clock on the church tower. Several children and adults in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the street. On the right side are multi‑story townhouses with shops; one facade bears the large sign "Stadt‑Park."
